question.text: Continuing Sona Fund: Year-2 GAV = INR 104 crore, other expense assumptions unchanged (set-up INR 0.40 cr, yearly expense INR 0.48 cr, mgmt fee 1.5% on GAV incl. 18% GST). The Year-2 REFERENCE HURDLE NAV (compounded 10% on INR 80 crore over 2 years) is closest to:

explanation.text: The Logic: Reference Hurdle NAV Year 2 = INR 80 x (1.10)^2 = INR 80 x 1.21 = INR 96.80 crore. (Chapter: hurdle is a COMPOUND rate in closed-ended Cat I/II.) The Trap: A is Year-1 hurdle (INR 80 x 1.10 = 88); C is GAV; D is a simple-interest approximation (10% x 2 = 20% x 80 = 16 + 80 = 96, off by INR 0.8 cr). Cross-Exam Context: Example 6.3 chapter pattern. XIX-C tests.
